rules: Use one icon library per project. Mixing libraries mixes stroke widths, corner radii and optical sizes.
Match the icon's stroke weight to the text it sits beside: about 1.5 px for 400-weight text at 16 px, 2 px for 500-600 weight.
Size icons to the text cap-height or line-height: 16 px with 14-16 px text, 20 px with 18 px text, 24 px in toolbars and tab bars.
Icon-only controls need an accessible name; decorative icons next to text are aria-hidden.
Keep the hit area at least 24×24 CSS px (44 pt/48 dp on touch) even when the glyph is 16 px.
Use currentColor so icons inherit text colour and theme changes.
Import icons individually (tree-shaken components or an SVG sprite); never ship a whole icon font.
Brand logos are not icons: use the brand's official asset, not a lookalike glyph.

roles.guidance: Outline style at rest, filled for the selected tab on mobile. Chevrons mirror in RTL.
roles.label: Always pair with a visible text label in tab bars; icon-only only for universal back/close with aria-label.

roles.guidance: Same style as navigation. Destructive actions get text, not only a trash icon.
roles.label: Icon-only allowed in dense toolbars with aria-label plus tooltip; primary actions use text.

roles.guidance: Distinct shapes (check, triangle, octagon/circle-x, circle-i) so status never depends on colour.
roles.label: Pair with status text; aria-hidden on the icon when text is present.

roles.guidance: Helps scanning in lists and menus; keep consistent per object type across the product.
roles.label: Decorative next to the object name: aria-hidden.

roles.guidance: Inside fields at 16-20 px; the clear and reveal icons are buttons.
roles.label: Buttons inside fields need names ("Show password", "Clear search").

roles.guidance: Filled glyphs read better at small sizes over video. Never mirror in RTL.
roles.label: Name reflects the current action ("Pause video") and updates on toggle.

roles.guidance: Arrows for change must also carry sign and number.
roles.label: Sort state goes in aria-sort, not only the arrow.

roles.guidance: Larger (32-48 px) and may use a duotone of the same family; never a different library from the UI.
roles.label: Decorative: aria-hidden, the heading carries the meaning.

libraries.name: Lucide
libraries.style: outline, 2 px default stroke (adjustable), 24 px grid
libraries.fits: general product UI, dashboards, marketing sites

libraries.name: Phosphor
libraries.style: six weights (thin to fill, duotone) of one set
libraries.fits: brands needing weight matching with type; illustrative + UI from one family

libraries.name: Material Symbols
libraries.style: variable font/SVG: weight, fill, grade, optical size axes
libraries.fits: Material and Android-leaning products; Compose and Flutter

libraries.name: SF Symbols
libraries.style: weights and scales that match San Francisco text automatically
libraries.fits: iOS/macOS native apps only (licence limits use to Apple platforms)

libraries.name: Radix Icons
libraries.style: 15 px grid, crisp at small sizes

libraries.name: Dashicons / WordPress Icons
libraries.fits: WordPress admin and block editor UI only
